description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E (%) performance across three different model scales in the LLaMA-2 family—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four distinct training conditions, as indicated by the legend: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀” (orange with horizontal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal stripes), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (pink with diagonal stripes). The horizontal axis lists the model scales in ascending order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents CoLeG-E (%) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each model scale, four bars are grouped together, showing the performance under each SFT condition. The shortest bar in the chart corresponds to the “no SFT” condition for the LLaMA-2-7B model, with a value of approximately 4%. The tallest bar corresponds to the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” condition for the LLaMA-2-70B model, reaching approximately 51%. Within each group, the bars are ordered from shortest to tallest, indicating that adding more data (D₀, D₁, D₂) to the SFT training consistently increases performance for all model sizes. The bars are visually distinct by color and pattern, and there are no annotations or special visual emphasis beyond the standard bar representation.
